message.content:
Sure thing! To get you set up with the best option, could you let me know:

| Detail | What I Need |
|--------|-------------|
| **Destination** (city & state) | e.g., “Oakland, CA” |
| **Travel date(s)** | If it’s one‑way or round‑trip, plus exact dates |
| **Preferred departure time** | Morning/afternoon/evening? Any flexibility? |
| **Number of adults** | How many people will be traveling? |
| **Class preference** | Value, Flexible, or Business |
| **Trip protection** | Would you like extra coverage for cancellations/change fees? |

Once I have those pieces, I’ll pull up the schedules and lock down your seats. 🚆
